import pychrono.core as chrono

import math

veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the MAN vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('MAN 10t Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 15.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())


# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()
    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1
    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as chrono_vehicle

# Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
sys = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create the vehicle model
vehicle = chrono_vehicle.ChVehicle()
vehicle.SetContactMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionShape(chrono.ChBox(1, 1, 1))
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(chrono.ChVisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.SetChassisMeshFile("path/to/chassis/mesh.obj")

# Create the TMEASY tire model
tire = chrono_vehicle.ChTireTMEASY()
tire.SetTireSize(chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0.2, 0.1))
tire.SetTireMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())

# Create the vehicle parts (chassis, suspension, wheels, etc.)
chassis = vehicle.GetChassis()
suspension = chrono_vehicle.ChSuspension()
suspension.SetSuspensionType(chrono.ChSuspensionType.REVOLUTE)
suspension.SetSpringConstant(10000)
suspension.SetDampingCoefficient(100)
wheels = []
for i in range(4):
    wheel = chrono_vehicle.ChWheel()
    wheel.SetTire(tire)
    wheel.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 0, 0))
    wheels.append(wheel)

# Add the vehicle parts to the vehicle model
vehicle.Add(chassis)
vehicle.Add(suspension)
for wheel in wheels:
    vehicle.Add(wheel)

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(sys, 10, 10, 1, 1000, True, True)

# Set the initial position of the vehicle
vehicle.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1))

# Set the default parameters for the simulation
sys.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # gravity
sys.SetStep(0.01)  # time step
sys.SetMaxiter(100)  # maximum number of iterations

# Create the Irrlicht visualization system
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle("MAN 10t Truck Simulation")
vis.SetCamera(chronoirr.ChCamera())
vis.SetCameraPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 5))
vis.SetCameraLookAt(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))

# Create a chase camera
chase_cam = chronoirr.ChCamera()
chase_cam.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 5))
chase_cam.SetLookAt(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddCamera(chase_cam)

# Add directional lighting
light = chronoirr.ChLight()
light.SetType(chronoirr.ChLightType.DIRECTIONAL)
light.SetDirection(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 1))
vis.AddLight(light)

# Add a skybox
skybox = chronoirr.ChSkybox()
skybox.SetTexture("path/to/skybox/texture.png")
vis.AddSkybox(skybox)

# Add terrain textures and logos
terrain_texture = chronoirr.ChTexture()
terrain_texture.SetTexture("path/to/terrain/texture.png")
vis.AddTexture(terrain_texture)

logo = chronoirr.ChLogo()
logo.SetTexture("path/to/logo/texture.png")
vis.AddLogo(logo)

# Set the driver controls
driver = chrono_vehicle.ChDriver()
driver.SetSteering(0.5)
driver.SetThrottle(0.5)
driver.SetBraking(0.5)
vehicle.Add(driver)

# Run the simulation
while sys.GetChTime() < 10:
    sys.DoStepDynamics(0.01)
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.DrawAll()
    vis.EndScene()
    vis.DoStep()
```
Note that this script assumes that you have the necessary dependencies installed, including PyChrono, Irrlicht, and the vehicle model and tire model libraries. Additionally, you will need to replace the placeholder file paths with the actual paths to your mesh files, texture files, and logo files.
